ar.meaning: شَكَّلَ السَّطْحَ عَلَى هَيْئَةِ قَوْسٍ كُرَوِيٍّ مُحَدَّبٍ

en.infinitive: to grind into a spherical curvature
en.meaning: to fashion and polish an optical surface into a convex spherical dome

conjugation_examples.ar: يُكَوِّرُ الصَّانِعُ قِمَّةَ العَدَسَةِ بِحَرَكَةٍ دَائِرِيَّةٍ مُحْكَمَةٍ.
conjugation_examples.de: Der Handwerker wölbt die Linsenkuppel mit gleichmäßigen Kreisbewegungen.
conjugation_examples.en: The craftsman grinds the lens dome with controlled circular motions.

conjugation_examples.ar: كَوَّرَ البِلَّوْرِيُّ حَجَرَ المَرْوِ حَتَّى تَسَاوَى انْحِنَاؤُهُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الجِهَاتِ.
conjugation_examples.de: Der Kristaller wölbte den Quarzkristall, bis die Krümmung von allen Seiten homogen war.
conjugation_examples.en: The crystal lapidary ground the quartz stone until its curvature was symmetrical from all angles.
